algorithm.anchor: A = first completed minute close; earliest inventory entry at next minute open (index 1).
algorithm.equity: 1000 USDT hypothetical unlevered accounting buffer plus signed trade cash ledger plus inventory * observed trade close. Buffer is a denominator only and not a personal budget; not mark-equity or liquidation simulation.
algorithm.exposure: Same initial .002 BTC for active arms; grid cap .004 BTC differs from static hold .002. Report time-average and peak quantity, not exposure-matched alpha.
algorithm.fifo: Sell oldest lots first; store complete inventory/cash/equity and FIFO realized PnL before and after forced terminal exit.
algorithm.funding: Actual settlement funding cashflow unknown; not imputed or implicitly included in friction component.
algorithm.grid_always: Apply target after every close t=0..1438. No recalibration, restart, stop loss or path-based limit fill.
algorithm.grid_dormant: Same target until first closed minute abs(C[t]/A-1)>=0.01. Then target 0 at next open and remain permanently dormant for this sample; even upper-side breakout qualifies. No intrabar trigger.
algorithm.hold_initial: Buy 2 lots at open[1], unchanged until terminal liquidation.
algorithm.normalized_contract_quantity: Uses historical 0.01 BTC/contract only as identity context; quantities are research normalization, not verified current valid orders.
algorithm.target: At each closed minute t, k=truncate_toward_zero((C[t]/A-1)/0.0025); target_lots=clip(2-k,0,4). At open[t+1], fill delta to this target at explicit price proxy.
algorithm.terminal_exit: At terminal last-minute close (index1439), liquidate all inventory, including exit fee and slippage scenario. This terminal price is a declared retrospective proxy, not proof of executable close.
algorithm.wait: No inventory or trades; cash price component 0, not a trade observation.

disclosure.scope: Authored analysis and aggregate diagnostics only. No upstream rows, raw files, event/equity series or browser full text redistribution.

limitations: Already exposed one-day development file; no holdout or independent economic validation.
Close signal and next-open/terminal-close execution prices are explicit proxies, not actual fill or limit queue evidence.
FIFO nonterminal realized price PnL is not exchange paired grid-cycle profit.
Actual funding, fees, mark-equity and net PnL remain unknown.
Time-varying inventory differs from static hold; no alpha ranking or selected strategy.
Current work lacks a sealed future/cross-day contract supported by installed formal evaluator; method selftest does not confer production replay status.
Source event completeness and same-millisecond executable ordering unknown; minute-sampled drawdown may miss intraminute risk.

methodology.ledger: Signed reference and friction-adjusted cash, FIFO realization, full residual inventory and terminal exit; Decimal precision40.
methodology.scope: Unlevered equivalent price-component bookkeeping, not futures margin/mark/liquidation evaluator.
